incident_text: De fortes inondations touchent un quartier résidentiel de Nabeul. Plusieurs routes sont bloquées et l'eau continue de monter.

result.scene_summary: A town square flooded with muddy water, submerging the ground floors of several multi-story buildings.

observations.description: Muddy brown water covering the entire street, reaching the ground floors of buildings.
Multi-story buildings with arched doorways, windows, and balconies; one building has a sign that reads 'PUBBLICA RISCHIO ESECUZIONE' and another has 'A2' above windows.
No vehicles visible in the flooded area.
A stop sign and direction sign are visible on the right side, partially submerged in water.
